items.text: Dean Pretorius joined the lab as a PhD student.
“MV-UMI: A Scalable Multi-View Interface for Cross-Embodiment Learning” was accepted in IEEE Access.
“K-VARK: Kernelized Variance-Aware Residual Kalman Filter for Sensorless Force Estimation in Collaborative Robots” was accepted in IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering.

“Escaping the Trap: Benchmarking Swarm Gradient-Following in Geometrically Constrained Environments” received a Best Video Award at ANTS 2026 in Darmstadt, and was runner-up for the Best Poster Award on the conference’s first day.
Nilay Kushawaha joined the lab as a postdoctoral researcher.
“Receding-Horizon Nullspace Optimization for Actuation-Aware Control Allocation in Omnidirectional UAVs” was accepted at the International Conference on Unmanned Aircraft Systems (ICUAS) 2026.
“Learning-Based Robust Control: Unifying Exploration and Distributional Robustness for Reliable Robotics via Free Energy” was accepted at IEEE ICRA 2026.
“A Framework for Soft Robot Control: Integrating Physics-Based Modeling with Exploration-Based Learning” was accepted at IEEE ICRA 2026.
“Escaping the Trap: Benchmarking Swarm Gradient-Following in Geometrically Constrained Environments” was accepted as a short paper at ANTS 2026, the International Conference on Swarm Intelligence.
“Safe and Stable Neural Network Dynamical Systems for Robot Motion Planning” was accepted in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters.
“Constrained Trajectory Optimization on Matrix Lie Groups via Lie-Algebraic Differential Dynamic Programming” was accepted in Systems & Control Letters.
Fares J. Abu-Dakka gave the invited talk “Safe Robot Learning and Control: Challenges, Strategies, and Innovations” at the University of Trento.
Fares J. Abu-Dakka gave the talk “Empowering Communities with Cognitive Robots” at the UAE Pavilion, Expo 2025 Osaka.
“Evaluating Human–Robot Skill Gaps in Electrical Circuit Inspection: A New Electronic Task Board for Benchmarking Manipulation” was accepted at IEEE ICRA 2025.
“MeshDMP: Motion Planning on Discrete Manifolds using Dynamic Movement Primitives” was accepted at IEEE ICRA 2025.
Fares J. Abu-Dakka joined NYU Abu Dhabi as Assistant Professor of Mechanical Engineering, directing REACH Lab.
